text.p: -- Furman Selz analyst Ernest Jacob said he added Danielson Holding Corp to the firm's recommended list.
-- The recommendation is based on Danielson's announcement last night that Progressive Corp will acquire about 42 percent of Danielson's outstanding shares for $6.60 per share.
-- Progressive will also name four individuals to Danielson's board, important becuase Danielson lost its operating manangement in the TWA flight 800 crash.
-- " ... the appeal to Progressive lies in Danielson's $1.4 billion net operating loss and its modest book of nonstandard auto insurance," Jacob wrote.

-- "Progresive will clearly take an active role in helping Danielson grow and to achieve profitability. We believe that Progressive will pursue strategies designed to maximize the NOL. We would expect Danielson to be worth 2.0 times its growing book value, or possibly $12 to $14 per share in two years," the anaylst said.
-- Shares rose 2-1/4 to 9-1/8, easing off an earlier, new year-high of 9-3/8. The previous year high was 8-3/8.
